## Description:

**Related issue (if applicable):** fixes #25233

issue_context.title: Smartthings Climate on-off switch missing after 0.96 update
issue_context.body:
**Home Assistant release with the issue:**
0.96.0

**Last working Home Assistant release (if known):**
0.95.4

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
hassio

**Component/platform:**
Smartthings integration


**Description of problem:**
After 0.96.0 update, Climate entites imported with Smartthings integration no longer have the on/off switch.
In addition, the Auto program has been renamed to Heat/Cold, which is incorrect because the program on the hveac is really called Auto.
comments:
+1 
cannot turn on the climate without the switch (simply selecting hvac mode doens't turn on the unit) or turn off.

Hey there @andrewsayre, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`smartthings`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L234) for? Thanks!

_This is a automatic comment generated by [codeowners-mention](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant) to help ensure issues and pull requests are seen by the right people._

RE: `auto` rename, there is still some confusion around this and the HA name might not actually mean the same as the thermostat name. There is a discussion about it [here](https://github.com/home-assistant/architecture/issues/260).

on/off support was initially removed in Climate 1.0 and added back to the entity but not the ST A/C platform--so I'll re-add those services.

Regarding `auto`/`heat_cool` -- that is working as intended.  HA represents Climate using its own schema as an abstraction for many types of devices which isn't always going to match each individual physical device.  In Climate 1.0, `auto` means that there are no temperature set-points, vs `heat_cool` represents what was previously `auto`.

I thank you for clearing that up.
With regard to the on-off, will be reintroduced as a switch within the properties of the climate, or can you set a button in the frontend (thermostat card type ) as the fast selector mode?
I hope I've explained myself...

It has the effect of showing it alphabetically, I believe.  Yes, I the UI should order them as it intends instead of relying on each platform to return a specific sequence. 👍
